problem: Hanumān is reporting Rāma's words in Laṅkā; the Hindi marks this with 'कहा है', but the English 'Śrī Rāma said:' reads like narration of Rāma speaking in the scene.
fix: This is what Śrī Rāma said: Sītā, in separation from you, all things have turned contrary for me. The trees' new leaves seem like fire, night is like the night of doom, and the moon like the sun.

problem: 'वे चल पड़े और बागमें प्रवेश किया' joins an intransitive subject (वे) to a transitive past verb that needs उन्होंने; mixed construction.
fix: सिर नवाकर वे चल पड़े और बागमें जा घुसे; फल खाकर वे पेड़ोंको तोड़ने लगे। वहाँ रखवालीपर बहुत-से योद्धा तैनात थे; कुछ उनके हाथों मारे गये और कुछने जाकर दुहाई दी।

problem: 'हनुमान्‌जीने … ललकारा और … गरजे' gives one subject both the ergative ने and an intransitive verb; mixed construction (also पुनि is 'फिर', not 'तब').
fix: फिर उसने अक्षयकुमारको भेजा, जो अपार सुभटोंको साथ लिये चला। उसे आता देख हनुमान्‌जी पेड़ उठाकर ललकार उठे, और उसे मार गिराकर बड़े जोरसे गरजे।

problem: 'caught and mixed with the dust' is a word-for-word calque of धरि धूरि मिलएसि and not natural English.
fix: Some he killed, some he crushed, some he seized and ground into the dust; and some once more went and cried: My lord, the monkey's strength is enormous.

problem: अति बिसाल (exceedingly huge) is rendered only 'विशाल'; अति is dropped (the English 'enormous' keeps it).
fix: एक बहुत ही विशाल पेड़ उखाड़कर उन्होंने लंकापतिके बेटेको रथहीन कर दिया। उसके संग जितने महाबली योद्धा थे, उन्हें हनुमान्‌जी एक-एक करके पकड़ते और अपनी देहसे दबाकर कुचल डालते।

problem: ब्रह्मबान कपि कहुँ तेहिं मारा = he struck Hanumān with the Brahmā arrow (it hit him; the English says 'struck'); 'चलाया' says only that it was launched. Also लै गयऊ = took him away, not 'ले चला' (set off with him).
fix: उसने हनुमान्‌जीपर ब्रह्मबाणसे प्रहार किया; गिरते-गिरते भी उन्होंने उसकी सेनाका संहार कर दिया। हनुमान्‌जीको मूर्च्छित हुआ देखकर वह उन्हें नागपाशमें बाँधकर ले गया।

problem: Hanumān's speech (21.cau2–21.do21) is one relative-correlative sentence; the English opens it with nominative 'he whose strength…', which never gets a verb and is resumed in 21.do21 as 'the messenger of him'. 'The one' fits both ends.
fix: What offence did the demons commit, that you killed them? Tell me, wretch, have you no care for your life? Hear me, Rāvaṇa: the one whose strength enables māyā to fashion the hosts of universes;

problem: The Hindi heading is Gita Press's own heading with its compounds split ('अशोकवाटिका-विध्वंस, अक्षयकुमार-वध और मेघनाद…' → 'अशोकवाटिकाका विध्वंस, अक्षयकुमारका वध और मेघनाद…'); the brief asks for headings not in their wording. The English heading is fine.
fix: हनुमान्‌जीका अशोकवाटिका उजाड़ना, अक्षयकुमारको मारना और मेघनादके हाथों बँधना

problem: Agree कहेहू तें = even by telling, but the suggestion replaces the imperative sense, which ayodhya.151.cau3 needs (तात प्रनामु तात सन कहेहू = tell my father). Add, do not replace.
fix: कहेहू: कहना (आज्ञार्थक) / कहनेसे भी (कहेहू तें) | tell (him) / even by telling (kahehū te̐) (root कहना)

problem: Agree the line needs 'will take away' (लै जैहहिं), but 'will be (killed)' is not wrong: bal.271.cau3 न त मारे जैहहिं सब राजा = all the kings will be killed. The suggestion drops it. Add, do not replace.
fix: जैहहिं: जाएँगे | will go / will be (killed) (मारे जैहहिं) / will take away (लै जैहहिं) (भविष्यत्, बहुवचन, root जाना)

problem: Agree ताहि सन बाजा = closed with him in fight, but the suggestion drops 'musical instruments', which bal.92.cau3, bal.193.cau3 and lanka.78.cau4 need; lanka.76.cau4 (घाउ न बाजा) also uses 'struck, landed'. Add, do not replace.
fix: बाजा: वाद्य, बाजे / भिड़ा, जा लड़ा (ताहि सन बाजा) / लगा (घाउ न बाजा) | musical instruments / clashed with, closed in fight / struck, landed (a blow)

problem: Agree गरुड़ असंका = fearless, but the suggestion replaces 'doubt', which bal.12.cau4 (करिहहिं जे असंका), bal.72.cau2 (तजहु असंका) and bal.113.cau1 need. Add, do not replace.
fix: असंका: शंका, आशंका / निःशंक, निडर | doubt, misgiving / fearless (root आशंका / अशंक)

problem: Agree the line needs 'sustain, preserve', but 'observing' is right in ayodhya.274.cau3 (पालत नीति = observing policy); the suggestion drops it. Add, do not replace.
fix: पालत: पालन करते हुए, पालते हैं | observing / sustain, preserve (वर्तमान कृदंत, root पालना)

problem: कदराई is glossed only as a verb (डरता / सकुचाता है | shrinks); in तजहु कदराई it is the noun 'faint-heartedness', as also in bal.260, aranya.19 and kishkindha.29. Not listed by the writer.
fix: कदराई: डरता / सकुचाता है / कायरता, कातरता | shrinks, is timid / faint-heartedness, timidity (root कदराना)

problem: खाइ is glossed only 'खाकर | having eaten'; in गरुड़हि खाइ परम लघु ब्याल it is finite 'eats, devours' (also ayodhya.47 कालु न खाइ, lanka.82). Not listed by the writer.
fix: खाइ: खाकर / खाता है, खा जाता है | having eaten / eats, devours (पूर्वकालिक क्रिया / वर्तमान, root खाना)

problem: भूखा is glossed only 'hungry'; in मोहि अतिसय भूखा लागि it is the noun भूख, hunger (also uttar.88 लागी अति भूखा). Not listed by the writer.
fix: भूखा: भूखा / भूख | hungry / hunger

problem: ते is glossed 'वे / से | they / from'; in तुम्ह ते प्रेमु राम कें दूना it means 'than' (comparison), which the entry lacks.
fix: ते: वे / से (अपादान, तुलना) | they / from, than (सर्वनाम (बहुवचन) / कारक चिह्न, root वह)

problem: संघारा is glossed only as the noun 'destruction'; in कटकु संघारा it is the verb 'destroyed, slew' (also lanka.48 कटकु कपिन्ह संघारा).
fix: संघारा: संहार / संहार किया, मार डाला | destruction / destroyed, slew (root संहार)

problem: जाकें is glossed 'in whose'; in जाकें बल it is 'by whose (strength)' (also ayodhya.25 बाहँबल जाकें, aranya.15 गुन बस जाकें).
fix: जाकें: जिसके (यहाँ/हृदयमें) / जिसके (बलसे, वशमें) | in whose / whose, by whose (संबंधवाचक, root जो)

problem: बाधा is glossed 'obstacle / hinders, binds'; in तोहि न प्रान कइ बाधा it means danger or fear for one's life (Skt. bādhā: distress, danger), which the entry lacks.
fix: बाधा: बाधा, विघ्न / संकट, भय / बाधा देता है (बाँधता) | obstacle / danger, fear / hinders, binds (root बाधा / बाधना)
